description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.name: Screams from Within
uses.cardState: attached to another creature you control
